 General Election - November 3, 2026 - Election Day! 
 Published 7/16/2026 08:46:47 AM
 The general election is held in even-numbered years to elect federal, state, county and township officers. Constitutional amendments and public measures for cities and counties may also be on the ballot.
 Polls are open today from 7:00 am - 8:00 pm! 
 To find your polling place, use the Secretary of State's precinct locator tool , or find your precinct on the table below. 
 Absentee ballots must be received  in the Polk County Election Office by 8:00pm today. 
 Election Day Registration 
 Voters needing to change their address or register to vote can do so at the polling place  for their new address.
 Election Day Registrants will need to show proof of identification   and   proof of residency . A valid Iowa driver's license or non-operator ID with the correct address can be used for both.
 Proof of Identity 
 (Must include a photo and valid expiration date. An electronic driver's license or non-operator ID will  NOT  be accepted). 
 Iowa Driver's License/Non-Operator ID (no more than 90 days expired)
 Out-of-state driver's license or non-operator ID
 U.S. Passport
 U.S. Military or Veteran ID
 ID card issued by employer
 High school or college student ID card
 Tribal ID card or document
 Iowa Voter Identification Card (must be signed)
 Proof of Residence 
 (Must include name and current address and be current within 45 days. May be electronic or on paper ). 
 Iowa Driver's License/Non-Operator ID
 Residential lease
 Property tax statement
 Utility bill
 Bank statement
 Paycheck/paystub
 Government check or document
 Tribal ID or document
